spans.s:
mf. (-तः-ती)
The young of any animal.
m. (-तः)
1 A young elephant of ten years old.
2 A vessel, a ship, a boat.
3 The site of a house or dwelling.
4 Cloth.
E.
पूञ् to purify, तन् Uṇādi aff.

f. (-की)
A potherb, (Basella lucida.)
E.
पूत nominal verb, from पूत a stench, वुञ् aff., ङीप् fem. aff.

m. (-जः)
An animal that produces young at once without the intervention of any medium; elephants and some other animals being supposed in Hindu physiology to carry the young without the aid of an ovarium or uterus.
E.
पोत young, and जन to bear, aff. ड.

m. (-णिक्)
A voyaging merchant.
E.
पात a boat, and वणिक् a trader.

m. (-क्षः)
The rudder of a boat, or large oar used as one.
E.
पोत a boat, रक्ष to preserve, अच् aff.

m. (-यः)
One of the Jinas or Jaina deified teachers.

m. (-हः)
A rower, a boatman, a steersman, a towman, or one of the crew that keeps watch at the mast-head.
E.
पोत a boat, वह to bear, अण् aff.

n. (-नं)
A tent.
E.
पोत cloth, आच्छादन covering.

n. (-नं)
Small fry, a shoal of young fish.
E.
पोव, and आधान taking; being caught in bags.

f. (-का)
A potherb, (Basella rubra and lucida.)
E.
पूत nominal verb, to stink, aff. वुन्, fem. aff. टाप्.

m. (-ता)
1 One of the officiating priests at a sacrifice.
2 A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
पू to make pure, aff. तृच्.

n. (-त्रं)
1 The snout of a hog.
2 The share of a plough.
2 The thunderbolt of INDRA.
E.
पू to make pure, ष्ट्रन् aff.

m. (-धः)
A hog.
E.
पोक्ष a snout, आयुध a weapon.

m. (-जः)
A gem, supposed to be found in the tooth of a hog.
E.
पोत्रि a hog, दंष्ट्रा a tooth, and ज born.

m. (-त्री)
A hog.
E.
पोत्र the snout, इनि aff.

f. (-था)
One of the Śaktis or female divinities of the Jainas.
E.
पोत्रि a hog, and रथ a vehicle.
